author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
It's ARMAGEDDON... without the Aerosmith or self-sacrificing Bruce Willis. We're back with a look at the new 40k Launch Box for the 11th edition of this massively popular tabletop game. Have they changed? Will we take them back? Let's find out.

Thanks to Games Workshop for the complimentary copy of the box to review.

author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
It's the second part of our five-part review of 11th Edition's launch products today and we're having a look at the new Chapter Approved deck. This replaces the 2025-26 deck with a new system of variable Primary Missions based on your Force Disposition, new setup and objective placement rules married with Terrain Areas and a whole new slew of other content. 

Thanks to Games Workshop for the complimentary copy of the box to review.
